verdict.rationale: BugSnag's integrations docs say it can "create and sync issues in Jira, or your team's issue tracker," so ticket creation with some sync is a first-party capability. The evidence does not show that the sync is two-way or that ticket and error status are coupled. missing for 10: named GitHub Issues and Linear support, documented two-way status sync, closing a ticket auto-resolving the error, a regression auto-reopening the linked ticket, hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can link an error to Jira, GitHub Issues, or Linear with two-way status sync, so fixing the ticket resolves the error and a regression reopens it

citations.quote: Create and sync issues in Jira, or your team's issue tracker.
